links: Converts mechanical strain to electrochemical signals
Maps fracture geometry and distant seismic swarms

journal.en: They don't see the dark; they listen to the rock breathe.

journal.en: A living submarine, tuned to the weight of a calcium sea.

Spends it in a single anaerobic-to-aerobic burst

skill.effect: Doubles movement speed and damage for 5s, then enters 10s cooldown (+2x speed/dmg)

chains.weakness: Leaves them completely anaerobic and sluggish until they recharge

journal.en: A match struck in a vault; one strike, then darkness.

links: Compensates for near-zero diffusion of scents
Grips rock walls during slow Darcy flow
Positions mouthparts into advective current veins

chains.weakness: Cannot reposition quickly if pinned by calcite precipitation
observe: Body remains perfectly still for hours
Cilia sweep only when flow changes

journal.en: Still as the crust itself, waiting for the chemical tide.

relations.note: (council kind 'competitor') Shares fracture space but avoids direct contact through vertical zoning; Tumbrela holds the mid-fracture, Cascavel hunts deeper.

temperament: Patient, reactive only to specific seismic frequencies
secrets: Can be befriended by mimicking their seismic frequency to approach silently.
Their vesicles can be harvested for one-time burst metabolism, but risk poisoning if overused.
moments: When a distant quake strikes, every Tumbrela turns its plates in unison, listening to the planet’s heartbeat across the dark.
